verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Term by term the integrand agrees: t ^ a i is Real.rpow with a real exponent (the paper's distinct real α_i), β j t is the paper's β_j(x), and the factors are in the same order. The one difference is the domain: the Lean definition body integrates over all of ℝ against Lebesgue measure, where the paper writes ∫_0^∞. The rewriting is routine and is carried out in the repository: under the standing hypotheses (β_j ≥ 0 supported in Icc (l j) (u j) with 0 < l j, which are hypotheses of bumpMomentMatrix_det_ne_zero, PowerMomentMatrix.lean:261, and fields lower_pos/bump_support of SmoothPowerMomentMatrix.Family, lines 104 and 108) the integrand vanishes off (0,∞), and Family.matrix_eq_positive_integral states exactly the paper's half-line formula. Note that the literal ∫_{Ioi 0} form appears only in the parametric Family setting (D.matrix p), not for the bare bumpMomentMatrix; Ioi 0 versus [0,∞) is a Lebesgue-null endpoint.
